## Description

Trades short-term Treasury bill yields against Federal Reserve Overnight Reverse Repurchase Agreement (ON RRP) facility rates and SOFR index dynamics.

## Where it may fit

Central bank interest rate hike/cut cycles, money market liquidity shifts, and treasury yield curve dislocations.

## Vehicles

Macro hedge funds, money market funds, fixed income arbitrage desks.

## Required data

FRED API SOFR rates, ON RRP usage metrics, yield curve spot rates, overnight Treasury bill prices.

## Caveats

Capital intensive with small basis points spread; typically requires high leverage via repo markets.
